business_summary: Hunan Mendale Hometextile Co.,Ltd provides home textiles in China and internationally. The company offers bedding sets, comforters, pillows, mattresses, and sofas. It sells its products under the Mengjie, Mei, MINE, Mengjie Baby, Mi, Meidazhai, and Pingshi Aesthetics brands through direct and franchised stores, traditional and social e-commerce channels, shopping mall counters, department and brand flagship stores, specialty and outlet discount stores, and group buying channels. The company also provides laundry and care services under the Mengjie Qixing Laundry and Care and Qixing Laundry and Care brands; and health consultation services. In addition, it is involved in the production of textiles, chemical fiber and feather products, clothing, shoes, hats, furniture, toys, arts and crafts, cultural and office supplies, leather and general labor protection products, medical masks and protective clothing, medical devices, and computer software and hardware; wholesale and retail of food, beverages, decoration materials, hotel equipment, household appliances, electronic products, hardware and electrical appliances, and electromechanical equipment; operation of children's amusement facilities; retail of books and periodicals; sale of audio-visual products; coffee shop operations, public relations event planning, wedding and etiquette, exhibition and display, photography, cleaning, household, dry cleaning, hairdressing and beauty, residential, call center, and information services; installation of air conditioning, electrical appliance, and refrigeration equipment; repair of household appliances, shoes, and leather products; rental of cultural and sports equipment; and real estate leasing activities. The company was formerly known as Changsha Mengjie Quilted Products Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hunan Mendale Hometextile Co.,Ltd in January 2001. Hunan Mendale Hometextile Co.,Ltd was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Changsha, China.
